And his intent is that the three first ones are included in the Yod: which are the cantillation marks in Keter, and the vowels in Chokhmah, and the letters in Binah; and this is clear and will be explained in this gate and in the Gate of Vowels and in the Gate of Cantillation Marks, with the help of the Rock and His salvation. And they are the secret of three brains, hinted in Chokhmah, which are the three Yods that are in the four-letter name in the filling Yod-Vav-Dalet, Heh-Yod, Vav-Alef-Vav, Heh-Yod. And of this it is said (Isa. 44:6), "I am the first," in the secret of the upper thorn, the first Yod; "and I am the last," in the secret of the lower thorn, the third Yod; "and beside Me there is no God," in the secret of the middle, the middle thorn, the second Yod. And all this is hinted in the secret of the Yod; and this is the very secret of "Alef, the thorn above," etc. Further, the Yod hints at the thirteen attributes of compassion that are within Keter, which are revealed by means of Chokhmah; and that is: Yod, its totality ten, and three Yods; behold, they are the thirteen measures of compassion:

The letter Kaf: he wrote in the Sefer ha-Temunah that this letter is hinted in Malkhut, all her vessels being prepared to receive from above; and it is from the language of "one golden spoon [kaf] of ten shekels" (Num. 7:14). And he explained: as the spoon is made to receive, so this is made to receive from Binah, which is the Lamed, as we shall explain. And its dominion is at the hour of the moon; for so it is fitting for it, as is explained above.

And there is one who explained that the Kaf is the Shekhinah in the secret of the moon, for she is like half a round threshing floor, in the secret of "Your navel is like a round goblet" (Song 7:3); and it is the Chamber of Hewn Stone, the place of the session of the Sanhedrin.
And there is one who explained: Kaf hints at the two pans [kapot] of the just balances, which are Netzach and Hod; as it is written (Lam. 3:41), "Let us lift up our heart with our hands [kappayim]."

And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Kaf: and the ways and the paths are of one matter. The Kaf of the twenty-two letters is called glory [kavod]; and it is the form of the fixed intellect; and it is its path." Thus far. And for us this letter hints at Binah, which is the upper Mother; and she is "one golden spoon of ten," for "out of the north comes gold" (Job 37:22); and she is full of incense, which is what binds all the worlds, and by her power they are united. Or it is possible that they are: the Kaf with dagesh, in the secret of the scale-pan of liability, Gevurah; the soft Kaf, in the secret of the pan of merit, Gedulah. And it is possible that it is in Malkhut, as it is written (Exod. 33:23), "And I will take away My hand [kappi]," with respect to the lower aspects that are in her; and it is with dagesh at the time of her receiving from Gevurah and soft at the time of her receiving from Gedulah. And in the Tikkunim (in the Introduction, fol. 6a), and many times, he explained: Kaf, Keter, in the secret of Yod from above to below and Yod from below to above; they are two Yods, that is, Kaf [20], whose explanation is Keter; and that is Keter in the aspect of Binah. And this is proved from several places, and we copied it in the Gate of From Below to Above, chapter 1:

The letter Lamed: see in the Sefer ha-Temunah that it is in Binah; and its language proves it; for it is the language of learning [limmud] and understanding. And its form shows that it is high over all. And its form is two attributes, Kaf-Vav, which are Malkhut and Tiferet: Malkhut beneath Tiferet, like a horse to the rider, standing beneath it to receive; and over her Tiferet, like a rider on the horse, raised up above to receive from Binah. And it seems to me that therefore the Vav is on the left side of the Kaf, to hint that it receives from Binah; for there is the principal of its place. And the commentator spoke at length there: that the four letters of the four-letter name testify to the bond of the sefirot and their union in the manifestation of its letters, as we explained in the Gate of the Four-Letter Name, chapter 3; and therefore these letters too testify to the union, and the testimony in them is double. How so? Alef in its filling is Alef: Alef points to the four-letter name, two Yods and the Vav that is in it; and it is also twenty-six [Lamed-Peh, as Kaf-Vav]; behold, the letter Alef testifies to the union, and its testimony is double, a seal within a seal. The second, the Lamed and the Mem that is with it. The third, the Mem: Mem itself is twenty-six, and the Mem that is with it is also twenty-six; behold a seal within a seal. The fourth, Samekh and the Mem that is with it; behold a seal within a seal. Behold four witnesses, which are the letters  A L M S; and their testimony, that they testify to the union, is double. And it is possible to say that the union to which they testify is the union of Tiferet and Malkhut, which are twenty-six, as is explained above. And let us return to our matter: this spiritual form has its principal in Binah, and her bestowal is hinted in Malkhut through Tiferet. And he said that its dominion is at the time of Saturn; and possibly the reason is because Binah is also the Great Sabbath, and on the Sabbath day the constellation is Saturn, as is known. And there is one who explained: in the whole of the Lamed, in its form above, is a Yod; and it is a hint to Keter, Chokhmah, Binah, Chesed, in the secret of its four extremities, as we explained concerning the Yod itself; and beneath the Yod a Vav, to hint at Tiferet; and beneath the Vav a Dalet, to hint at Malkhut; and beneath the Dalet a bent thorn, to hint at Metatron, the Prince of the Face, who sits first in the Kingdom. Further, he explained concerning the Lamed that the Lamed is a hint to Chesed, and the closed Mem hints at Gevurah; and therefore it is closed, a hint to the judgment and to the holding back of the effluence; and the open Mem hints at Tiferet in the middle, in the secret of the compassion that is intermediate between Chesed and judgment.
And there is one who explained that the Lamed hints at Malkhut, as it is said (Ps. 144:1), "who teaches [ha-melammed] my hands to war."

And there is one who explained in another sense, these are his words: "The Lamed is the form of a wondrous light, standing like the mirror of the intellect, from within which all is seen; and it is its path." And this letter Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained in the Song of Songs: that it hints at Binah. And likewise you will find that this letter is above all the letters, to hint that, even though all the letters have their beginning from Chesed downward, as we explained in chapter 3, nevertheless it has an ascent over them, in the secret of Binah, which is high over the seven days of the building:

The letter Mem: the author of the Sefer ha-Temunah explained that whether closed or open, both of them are a hint to Malkhut. The first, when she receives from the compassion and bestows below; and therefore it is open below, showing that her effluence goes down to the abyss and subdues it, so that its waters not rise and overturn the earth, and so that the springs not withhold from giving water to the world as is fitting. And the closed, to show that it gathers the power of judgment and holds it back so that it not descend. And the two of them come together to show the force of the double witness that testifies to the union, as we explained in the previous chapter. And the two of them together are the power of compassion: this in the holding back of judgment, and that in the bestowal of compassion. And its dominion is in Jupiter [Tzedek].

And there is one who explained that the Mem: its nose is in the likeness of Vav, it is Tiferet, Jacob; and its upper roof is Abraham, Chesed; and its lower floor is Isaac; and the wall that is behind it is the Shekhinah; the Mem is found to be the four living creatures of the Chariot, like this: . And its principal is in the Shekhinah, Malkhut (the closed); except that the open hints at the drawing of effluence, and the closed points to holding back (God forbid). Further, he explained concerning the closed Mem that it is in the form of two Dalets joined, a hint to the two Hehs bound to one another through Tiferet, which unites the upper world and the lower world. And it seems to me according to this that therefore the one Dalet turns upward and the one turns downward: the upper turns to bestow in the lower, and the lower turns upward to receive from the upper.
And there is one who explained: the open Mem is a hint to the male, who does not need guarding; the closed Mem is a hint to the female, who needs guarding.

And there is one who explained: the open Mem, clear light [or tzach]; and the other Mem, closed; and all is one thing; and its path is called clear and refined light. And according to the opinion of Rashbi, peace be upon him, Mem, whether open or closed, its hint is in Binah. And the difference between them is that when she bestows below she is open, and when the light is gathered within her and she does not bestow in the sefirot, then she is called closed Mem. However, it is square, to show that she crouches [rova'at] upon the belly of the four living creatures of the upper Chariot and is ready to bestow; which is not so in the Samekh, as we shall explain. And Rabbi Moshe [de León] explained in the Sefer ha-Shem that the closed Mem is in Malkhut (and see the Zohar, Acharei, fol. 66b, and in the Mikdash Melekh there, that there are two ways there):

The letter Nun: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that its form is in Binah, and it hints at the fiftieth gate, which bestows and acts through Malkhut. And the language of Nun hints as "let us destroy them [ninam] together" (Ps. 74:8), which is the language of multiplicity; and the intent is that from her effluence is drawn to the multitude of the creatures and the offspring that are in the world; and all through Malkhut, who receives from her and bestows abundant effluence to her maidens, as it is written (Prov. 31:15), "She rises also while it is yet night, and gives food to her household." And therefore its dominion is at the hour of the moon. And there is one who explained concerning the bent Nun and the straight: that the principal in the Nun is Tiferet; and therefore it is hinted in the Vav; for its principal is when it receives from the side of the right the compassion and the Chesed, and there is merit to bestow; and then it is the straight Nun, to bestow below. And when the merit is diminished and the effluence is held back, then it is the bent Nun, to hint at the gathering of the effluence within it and its holding back. Further, he explained the two Nuns in Malkhut; and the difference between them: when she has received the effluence and completed the matter of her receiving, then she is bent, to hint that she sits among her chariots to give food to her household; and when she stands upright to receive upon herself the diadem of Tiferet her husband, then she is straight, to hint at her standing for the honour of her husband. And there is one who explained Nun from the language of nunei, which are fishes, a hint to Yesod, which is "leviathan the piercing serpent": the crooked Nun hints at Malkhut, and the straight Nun hints at Yesod, which receives from above and bestows below. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Nun: two things, corresponding to the hidden light and the disposition of the primordial; and all became one thing; and therefore Moses was called faithful [ne'eman]; and it is from the derivation of faith; for from his power is faith, on the name of the verse (Isa. 25:1), 'O YHVH, You are my God; I will exalt You, I will praise,' etc.; that is to say, the father of faith, from whom it was emanated; and He is faithful in His creatures." And therefore there are two Nuns: the straight, its principal in Binah; the bent, its principal in Malkhut. However, its particulars are many: for the head of the Nun is a Yod, which points to Chokhmah; and beneath it a Vav, which points to Tiferet; and its bent tail is Malkhut; this is the law of the bent one. And the straight, in this way, except that it is straight, extending down to Yesod; and its lower thorn points to Malkhut; and all in straightness, in the secret of the middle line, to rise by way of there to her high house; which is not so with the bent one; for it is bent, falling beneath his feet. And because of this our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said (Berakhot 4b) that "Nun, in it is falling." And the head of the Nun includes the three first ones, in the secret of the Yod, which includes them: a thorn at the head and two thorns at its sides, to show the secret of the segolta. And there is no wonder in this at those who say that the straight Nun is in Keter. And in the Zohar, Parashat Acharei Mot (fol. 66b): (Yesod, Vav; the bent Nun, over it Vav; the straight Nun, over it Vav.) And there is a difference between Vav and Vav: the Vav of the bent Nun is the small Vav, Yesod; the Vav of the straight Nun is the upper Vav, Tiferet. And these are his words: "The bent Nun, this is the Lady; and the small Vav, which is Yesod, is adjacent to her, in order to be blessed from it. The straight Nun, the spreading out of Tiferet." He explained that when Tiferet bestows in the Lady, behold, its bestowal suffices to raise her up. And in the Zohar, Parashat Beha'alotekha (fol. 155b), he said that the bent Nun is female, and the straight is the inclusion of male and female as one, over which is Tiferet; and the bent is female alone, in which there is not Tiferet, which is the principal of the thing:

The letter Samekh: and he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that the spirituality of the letter Samekh is Malkhut; and the hint to her is that she is supported [semukhah] in the exile; and it is enclosed on every side, to show that "the mountains are round about Jerusalem" (Ps. 125:2), which are the powers that rebuke the husks, so that they not enter to defile the palace of the King, "and there shall no more come into her the uncircumcised and the unclean" (Isa. 52:1). And its dominion is at the hour of Venus [Nogah]. And there is one who explained that the Samekh is the Shekhinah supported by Tiferet, as it is said (Ps. 111:8), "They are established [semukhim] for ever and ever"; and therefore the Samekh is the Shekhinah, adjacent to the letter Nun, which is Tiferet, according to one of the explanations that he explained above; and the Nun turns its face toward her to water her. And there is one who explained that Samekh hints at Gedulah, which supports the upper and the lower ones. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Samekh: its path is a bright light, because it is covered over in its enclosure on every side." And in the Zohar (Terumah, fol. 127) Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained that its hint is in Binah, when she departs from over the children and is closed and concealed in the three upper sefirot and does not bestow; and because she increases to support the fallen, which are Yesod and Malkhut, therefore it is said of it (Ps. 145:14), "YHVH upholds [somekh] all that fall." And in Parashat Bereshit (fol. 35a) he explained that it is Malkhut; and therefore Samekh was not mentioned in the matter of the creation of Adam until it said va-yisgor ["and He closed up," Gen. 2:21]; for Tiferet is supported by Malkhut and Malkhut is supported by Tiferet; and of both of them it is said, "They are established for ever and ever." And it is possible to say that they do not disagree; for through the two faces being supported, in the secret of the bestowal of Binah, they are raised to Binah; and Binah is called Samekh [60], which is six extremities, included of ten; and that is Dalet-Vav [du]; and they are raised to Chokhmah; that is, Yod with Vav-Dalet, that is, Yod in its filling:

The letter Ayin: and he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that this letter has its principal in Yesod, which is called eye [ayin]: "the eye of YHVH is upon them that fear Him" (Ps. 33:18). And it is "the fountain [ein] of Jacob" (Deut. 33:28), which is Tiferet over Malkhut. And its form shows Nun, Zayin, Vav, whose explanation is that Yesod receives from Binah through Netzach and Tiferet. And its dominion is at the hour of Mercury; for it is over the moon as Yesod is over Malkhut. And there is one who explained: the Ayin is in Yesod, and it has two branches, right and left; from the right the side of holiness draws, and from the left the side of impurity draws, in the secret of the two sources that are in the covenant, one for the pure seed and the second for the filthy surplus. We have already explained this matter at length in the Gate of Channels, and there we copied his language letter by letter. Further, he explained that the Ayin is a hint to Malkhut and Tiferet; and Malkhut is the branch that sits within the great branch, to hint that she lies in the bosom of her beloved. And there is one who explained: Ayin hints at Malkhut; the explanation, that all the eyes and the visions and the colors are seen in her, and all of them act through her, as we explained in the Gate of Colors. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Ayin: its path is the throne of brightness; and it has two heads; and it is a standing body, open to receive the action of the work." And according to what is heard from the Zohar in some places, Ayin is Yesod; and it is called "he that has a bountiful eye shall be blessed" (Prov. 22:9), like the matter of their saying, "Say of the righteous, that it shall be well" (Isa. 3:10); and likewise "Blessings are upon the head of the righteous" (Prov. 10:6). And therefore the evil eye, which is from the side of the left, does not rule over it. And this is what is expounded (Berakhot 20a): "I come from the seed of Joseph," etc.; and the proof: "above the eye" [alei ayin] (Gen. 49:22). And there is another eye, and it is the open eye, over which there are no eyebrows at all; and it is in the upper secret, in Arikh Anpin, as is expounded in the Idra (Naso, fols. 129 and 130a):

The letter Peh: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that this letter is in Malkhut; and it is from the language of "for the one side [pe'ah]" (Exod. 27:9), "for the north side" (and likewise "the west side"; and she is called keren [corner], for she is "a precious corner stone"; and the uncircumcised Arameans "have the corners of their hair polled" [Jer. 9:25]). And the form of the letter shows that Kaf is the Shekhinah, and within her the sign of the holy covenant, which is Yesod, which is at her head, and is folded inward and enters within her; as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: "the Holy One, blessed be He, brings a great vessel into a small vessel." And its dominion is at the hour of Jupiter. And there is one who explained that Peh is a hint to the Holy One, blessed be He, and His court: for the Kaf is a hint to the Vav, Tiferet, rounded in the secret of the seventy of the Sanhedrin; and Malkhut, who is the Yod, agrees with them in judgment. And it seems to me, according to his way, that the Yod that is within the Kaf is a hint to Tiferet, the husband of the Lady; the Kaf is Malkhut, the court, in the form of the Chamber of Hewn Stone, as we explained in its entry.
And further he explained: Peh is Yod-Kaf, the union of Tiferet and Malkhut through the Righteous One, which is the covenant; for the covenant is Yod, the head of the Righteous One.

And further he explained that the Yod is Chokhmah, and the Kaf spreads out and rolls from its thorn; the upper Yod is Keter, which crowns and surrounds Chokhmah on its three sides. And there is one who explained: Peh and final Peh are Tiferet and Malkhut; and this is the secret of "With him do I speak mouth to mouth [peh el peh]" (Num. 12:8): the explanation, in the bestowal of Tiferet in Malkhut; and therefore the prophecy of Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, was in the shining mirror. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Peh and final Peh are one matter; they are called forms of intellect; and their path is called the light of greatness, which is called Chazchazit; that is to say, the place of the source of the vision of the seers." And therefore Malkhut is called Peh, for she is the place of entry and the gate to all the Emanation. And apart from this she is the mouth that speaks and reveals the upper Emanation. And the secret: in the Heh, the manifestation of the Yod, that is, her concealed manifestation; and the manifestation of "the round goblet" (Song 7:3), which surrounds the point of the navel; and that is Yod within the moon; and this is the secret of Heh; and likewise exactly the manifestation of Peh. And this is Heh-Yod, Heh-Yod that are in the four-letter name in the filling of Yods, like this: Yod, Heh-Yod, Vav, Heh-Yod. And its true form is like this. And the matter is that Binah too is a mouth; for she is what reveals every secret of the three first ones; and this is that both of them are called the upper and lower Shekhinah; and likewise mouths, and likewise the Hehs. And there is no doubt, in the secret of their bestowal with speed; and therefore they are open; and they are called mouths, for sometimes they are open and sometimes locked, bestowed upon and not bestowing; and therefore bent, concealed, open from the side. And the point of the Yod is to the left side, as the law of Heh-Yod, and not to the right, as the law of Yod-Heh, which is compassion, as is explained in the Gate of From Below to Above:

The letter Tzadi: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that it is hinted in the Righteous One, the Foundation of the World; and in it are Nun, Yod: the Nun in Binah and the Yod in Malkhut; and both of them in Yesod, to hint that Yesod [joins] the two attributes together. Further, another explanation; and this is the principal. And he said that its dominion is at the hour of the sun. And possibly the reason is that the sun is by the power of Tiferet; and the joining of these attributes is principally through Tiferet; and therefore its dominion is at the hour of the sun, "for YHVH God is a sun and a shield" (Ps. 84:12).

And further, for the matter of the sun is also related to Yesod, as is explained in its entry, with the help of Heaven. And there is one who explained that the Tzadi is in the Righteous One, the Foundation of the World; and its two branches are a hint to its two channels, the right and the left, as we explained in chapter 19 and in the Gate of Channels.

And further he explained that Tzadi is a hint to Malkhut, and its two heads are a hint to the two upper apples, on account of which she is called the field of apples, as we explained in the entry sadeh. And there is one who explained: Tzadi and final Tzadi are Tiferet and Malkhut; for they were created side by side until He separated them. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Tzadi and final Tzadi are intellected and bestowed; and their path is called the wheel of the Chariot; and it is the place of purity, where all the words of purity are equalized; and it points to them." And according to what is agreed in the Zohar and in the Sefer ha-Bahir, this letter, according to its sense, is in Yesod, when it is united in Malkhut; and its form proves it: for it is Yod, Yesod, and the bent Nun, Malkhut. And likewise it is not called Tzaddik except when it is united in Tzedek. And in the Zohar, Parashat Bereshit (in the Introduction, fol. 2b), he explained that the Tzadi, its principal is Nun-Yod. However, the Yod is the Yod of the Foundation of the World, of the male; and the Nun is of Malkhut. And behold, the Yod turns its face away from the Nun, to hint at the two faces that were before, at the beginning of the creation, as it is written (Ps. 139:5), "You have hemmed me in behind and before"; and the cherubim were not face to face. And therefore Yod rides upon Nun and turns its face from her. And nevertheless the principal of the Tzadi is in Yesod, and its name proves it; and possibly the reason is that it is what unites them, even if they are not face to face. And the long Tzadi they explained in the Tikkunim (in the Introduction, fol. 15a): that it is a hint to the Righteous One, the Foundation of the World, in the union of Binah; and this is the good that is treasured for the righteous in the time to come. And in chapter 26 we shall widen the explanation on the letters MaNTzPaKh, with the help of the Name:

The letter Kof: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that it is in Tiferet, from the language of "and his circuit [u-tekufato] unto the ends of it" (Ps. 19:7); for it is what goes round and surrounds. And its principal is in Malkhut; and it is the Kaf that is over the Vav, which is Tiferet, receiving from Binah. The rule of the matter: the Vav receives from Binah and bestows to Malkhut; and this is the intent of the letter. And its principal is in Malkhut; and it is open below, to bestow in the secret of the circuit. And its dominion is at the hour of the moon; for so it is in Malkhut. And there is one who explained in another sense, these are his words: "Kof: a matter and form of radiance, from where were the tablets of the covenant that were given by Moses our teacher, peace be upon him. And therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, is called the holy God, for He is holy in all matters of holiness. And the matter: the path of this light is called the Throne of Glory." And in the Zohar, especially in the Song of Songs, it appears explicitly that this letter is a hint to the serpent crooked in its tail; and it draws near to holiness, and appears "like an ape [kof] before human beings." And it is possible that the hint is to the Malkhut [of the husk]; and she is called kof, the explanation, from the language of kuppah [basket], for she receives everything:

The letter Resh: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that this letter is in Yesod; and it is a simple letter, which has no composition with another; and its extension reaches to Malkhut. And it is the language of inheritance, from the language of "go up, possess [resh]" (Deut. 1:21); for it is the inheritance of the righteous in the world to come; for there is the rest of the souls; and it is the world to come, a world that is wholly Sabbath; and therefore its dominion is in the constellation Saturn. And there is one who explained that the hint in it is in Malkhut, who is poor and wretched, from the language of "give me neither poverty [reish] nor riches" (Prov. 30:8); and close to this he explained in the Zohar in some places. And there is one who explained in another sense, these are his words: "Resh is the matter of the foundation of the beings; and it is its path, of the foundations of all the beings." And in the Zohar too it appears that it is Chokhmah; and he explained Resh, Reshit, Chokhmah. And behold, according to the language of Resh, its explanation is head [rosh]; and Chokhmah is head to the revealing of the Emanation, as we explained in the Gate of Whether the Ein Sof Is Keter. And elsewhere he explained that it is the language of poverty and wretchedness, as we explained above.

And behold, there is a great difference between Dalet and Resh, even though the hint of both letters is to wretchedness and poverty. For the Dalet has a thorn in it, and this thorn is a hint to Yesod, as we explained in chapter 7; but Resh has no thorn at all, to hint at poverty more; for even Yesod is not with her, but she is alone. And in it are two Vavs: the one drawn to the right is in Chesed, and the left roof is Gevurah; and over it a thorn at the end of the left roof, to hint that Yesod was diminished and draws from the side of Gevurah, in the secret of Isaac [Yitzchak], which is ketz [end] Chai, Yesod, taken to the left, as we explained in the preceding gates. And because of its departure to Gevurah, Malkhut remained poor from poverty, until YHVH looks down and has compassion:

The letter Shin: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that the hint of this letter is in Binah: and three Yods are the three first ones, and three Vavs are the three Patriarchs; and the Kaf, reversed upward, is Malkhut, in the secret of Yesod, to receive effluence from these sefirot. And its principal is in Netzach; for through it this fine joining is joined. And it is also in Binah, as we explained. And its dominion is at the hour of Mercury. And there is one who explained: Shin hints at Malkhut, from the language of "your teeth [shinnayikh] are like a flock of ewes" (Song 6:6); the explanation, that it is the teeth [crags] of the mountain, where the inhabitants of the city sit, so that the enemies not enter the city; so she sits at the gates of the King and guards herself so that a stranger not enter her. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Shin: I have already said at the letter Yod that it hints at the knot of the tefillin; and its path is called the substance of the action." And what is agreed in the words of Rashbi, peace be upon him, in the Zohar is that the Shin hints at the three Patriarchs, which are Gedulah, Gevurah, Tiferet; and the hint in it is the three Vavs of  V H V,  Y L Y,  S Y Ṭ, which are the three Patriarchs. And it hints also at Netzach, Hod, Yesod, in the generality of the Vavs, in the secret that they are included with the lines: the line of Chesed, the line of judgment, the line of compassion. And nevertheless the root of the Shin, that is, the point beneath it, in its base, the hint to it is in Binah or in Malkhut, in the secret of from below to above or from above to below, as we explained in the Gate of From Below to Above:

The letter Tav: he explained in the Sefer ha-Temunah that the hint of this letter is in Gevurah, showing judgment; and therefore it is said (Ezek. 9:4), "and set a mark [ve-hitvita tav]"; and our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said (Shabbat 55a) that six angels of ruin spread out in that matter. And this is the hint of the reversed Vav (that is, the leg of the Tav), which was the way of compassion and was turned to judgment; as (Exod. 9:3) "behold, the hand of YHVH is [hoyah]": Malkhut was turned to judgment from compassion, and the reversal of the Name shows judgment. And the word Tav is as "you shall mark out [teta'u] for you Mount Hor" (Num. 34:7); the explanation, a boundary and measure for judgment. And there is one who explained: Tav hints at Malkhut, from the language of "and set a mark," etc.; for all the inscriptions and the visions are seen in her. And there is one who explained in another sense, and these are his words: "Tav is over against the case of the tefillin; and its path is called peace." And in the Zohar, in many places, Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained: Tav, Tiferet. And it is possible to say that the language of tav is from the language of craving [ta'avah], as "behold, my craving [tavi] is that the Almighty would answer me" (Job 31:35); and the reason is that it is "a craving to the eyes and pleasant to the sight" (Gen. 3:6). Or it will be from the language of ot [sign]; and the reason is that Tiferet, from the side of Yesod, is a sign. And in the Zohar, Parashat Chukkat (fol. 180b), it is understood that this letter is hinted in Malkhut; and it is composed of two letters, and they are Resh or Dalet, for all is one, as we explained in chapter 23, for both of them show the poverty of Malkhut and her wretchedness; and likewise there is in it the letter Nun. And it is understood there that the Nun, its hint is in the Other Side, which stands at the lower parts of the Tabernacle; and the language of Nun is from the language of "you shall not wrong [tonu]" (Lev. 25:17); for the husk wrongs the man and shows him a shining face; it descends and leads astray, rises and accuses, "and her end is bitter as wormwood," as we explained in the Gate of the Palaces of the Substitutes. It is found according to this that the totality of this letter hints at Malkhut, with the totality of "the stone of stumbling" that is on the mouth of the well:

The letters final Kaf, final Mem, final Nun, final Peh, final Tzadi: in the Sefer ha-Temunah he explained that the letters MaNTzPaKh are hinted in Binah, the Salt Sea; for she is what gives salt and taste in all the worlds; and likewise these letters are at the end of the word, and they are at the rung of the five points that give salt in the whole cooked dish. And in the Zohar Chadash, Song of Songs (fol. 79), on the verse "rightly [meisharim] do they love you" (Song 1:4), Elijah, of blessed memory, explained: "Meisharim: they are the other letters that remained; and who are they? MaNTzPaKh; for there is none among all the letters that are called meisharim [straight ones] but these. And they are those that were doubled, straight ones with each other: Mem with final Mem, Nun with final Nun, Tzadi with final Tzadi, Peh with final Peh, Kaf with final Kaf; these are straight with each other, and this in that. For just as twenty-two letters are included, so are those that remained, which are 'rightly do they love you,' to be included with you in those twenty-two letters. These meisharim are letters concealed and stored away within the upper world. And when the first light was stored away, these letters were stored away; and Adam knew them. After Adam sinned, they were stored away as before, until Abraham came and knew them by the holy spirit that rested upon him. Afterward he bequeathed them to Isaac [as it is written, 'And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac' (Gen. 25:5)]; and Isaac bequeathed them to Jacob; and Jacob bequeathed them to Joseph. When Joseph died and the children of Israel were in exile, the letters were stored away and departed as before, until Israel stood at Mount Sinai and the Torah was handed over to Israel; and the letters were revealed; and Israel knew them in their clarity, in the secret of engraved Names, until they sinned. When they sinned, it is written, 'And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Horeb' (Exod. 33:6). And Moses and Joshua and the seventy elders knew them, and with them they entered the Land. When the Temple was built and this song was revealed, these letters were engraved in the twenty-two letters, the secret of BaKh [22]; and that is 'meisharim ahevukha' [rightly do they love you, read as: the straight ones love the twenty-two]; and it is written, 'You have established meisharim' (Ps. 99:4); 'and your palate like the best wine, that goes down sweetly [le-meisharim] for my beloved' (Song 7:10); all of them in the secret of these letters that are called meisharim. And these letters are crowns stored away within the world to come. And all of them are spring after spring within the Thought, in the engraving of the secrets of the holy Names, in the engravings of male and female, to agree as one. For there is no agreement among all the letters, one with another, to be this in that, except these." Thus far his words.

And according to the truth, the intent of Elijah in this saying is not to tell us that the manifestation of the form of the letters and their names was forgotten by them; for behold, Israel had Torah scrolls that Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, wrote for them, one for each and every tribe and one in the Ark. And there is no doubt that the Torah scrolls were made according to the law; and necessarily the MaNTzPaKh at the ends of words were according to their law. And if so, why would the form of these letters be forgotten from Israel? They would correct their books from the books of Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, and find it written and explicit. But the intent of Elijah, of blessed memory, in this is that, because the letters are the light of the sefirot from Chesed downward, as we explained in chapter 2 and in the preceding gates, and behold, this Emanation, which is the seven days of the building, is included in them; and likewise the letters came in it in five outlets, as we shall explain; and we widened this matter in the Gate of Fifty Gates.

And behold, because they were emanated from within Binah, necessarily the manifestation of five lights was portrayed in Binah, which are five sefirot: Gedulah, Gevurah, Tiferet, etc.; Tiferet, in which Yesod and Malkhut are included, in the secret of "body and covenant are counted as one," and in the secret of the [two] faces. It is found according to the truth that within Binah the seven days of the circuit are included in five; and that is the Heh that is in Binah. And when the sefirot spread out, there remained these manifestations of the five sefirot concealed within Binah; and they are sources for the emanated sefirot; and the seven days of the building receive from them, and they are sources to them. And it is known that every bestower is male with respect to the one bestowed upon, and the one bestowed upon female with respect to the bestower. And if so, it is found that the lights of MaNTzPaKh, which are the straight letters, which are called meisharim, are the lights of the five sefirot in straightness, in the way of the bestower; and the bent MaNTzPaKh are bestowed upon, in the joining of the other letters, whose totality is also in five outlets; they are females to them, receiving from them. And that is that the bent MaNTzPaKh are related as females to the straight MaNTzPaKh, as he said, "And they are those that were doubled, straight ones with each other," etc. And afterward he said that they were united with the twenty-two letters; as it appears, they too are related to them in the secret of those bestowed upon to the bestowers; because they are a source for all twenty-two, because they are vessels to the five lights concealed in Binah, in the secret of the light that was concealed for the righteous in the time to come; that is, the light of these five lights concealed in Binah; and they are bestowed upon, spread out and emanated from within the depths of Chokhmah; for from there those lights draw, lights concealed from them, which are there. And this is what he said: "They are crowns stored away within the world to come; and all of them are spring after spring within the Thought," etc.

And behold, what was concealed from Adam, and likewise from all of them, the matter is the secret of the five upper lights, which did not shine in them, and the ways of their powers; for only those fit to merit the world to come, while still in their lifetime, merited them. And that is "and they stripped themselves," etc. (Exod. 33:6). And this is what he said, "and with them they entered the Land": the explanation, by the light that was revealed from them upon them, they could be purified to enter the Land of Israel and to conquer seven nations and to break seven husks that rule in the Land of Israel; as it is written (Gen. 12:6), "And the Canaanite was then in the land": the secret of "Cursed be Canaan" (Gen. 9:25), the primordial serpent. And this is the secret of the letters MaNTzPaKh. And to relate each one to its fitting place we shall not trouble ourselves; for there are many faces upon faces, and we have no revelation except those that they explained in the Tikkunim, which is Yesod, the Righteous One; and of it is said: the good treasured for the righteous in the world to come. And there is no doubt that in this Righteous One Tiferet too is included; for it too is called righteous, as it is said (Ps. 145:17), "YHVH is righteous in all His ways," and as is explained in its entry. And by this the inquirer will examine closely, and it will profit him, with the help of the Name:

After we have occupied ourselves in the preceding chapters with the explanation of the twenty-two things, each one alone, according to what is found in the words of the commentators and of Rashbi, peace be upon him, as they have instructed us from Heaven, it is fitting now to explain the manifestation of the letters together as a whole. And this matter is explained in the Zohar, Parashat Terumah (fol. 167); and we shall not copy its language, for we have already copied it in the Gate of Substitutes. And it is explained there that the manifestation of the letters is in three aspects, which are light, waters, firmament. Light is the Emanation in a subtle manifestation, at the time of their emanation from Binah to Chesed; and still in Chesed they were in the manifestation of light, because there the things were not yet revealed in substance, and had not come into being in a revealed being, but like this light, which is simple, free of actual body. And afterward, from the drawing of the things from Chesed to Gevurah, what was light in Chesed in concealment, in their drawing and the spreading out of some of the things, the beings became thick and were revealed in the manifestation of waters; the explanation, that for their revealing, from what they were in Chesed to what they are in Gevurah, they are in great difference in the revealing of the beings, from light to waters; for the waters are substantial, corporeal, revealed. And there is no wonder in our saying that in Gevurah the manifestation of waters came into being, even though the waters are in Chesed and the fire in Gevurah; for the manifestation of these waters is waters in the secret of the joining of Gedulah to Gevurah, as is examined above from our words, and so they explained in the saying mentioned. And when the waters mentioned spread out further, the firmament comes into being from them; that is, the manifestation of a being more revealed and thicker than the waters; and that is in the secret of the spreading out of the letters up to Tiferet, where the firmament is.

And behold, the case of the letters in the spiritual form is like the case of the child in the manifestation of its coming into being: for in the brain of its father it is in the secret of light, a subtle power that spreads out from the brain until its coming near to its going out from the power of its father into the full womb, which is waters; and within those waters the child takes on body and becomes thick; and this is the manifestation of firmament. And this case happened to the five sefirot in which all seven days of the circuit are included, as we explained in the previous chapter. And therefore in the work of Creation, five times light and five times waters and five times firmament. And the sefirot and the letters have one matter; and therefore they are related in these three manifestations, which are light, waters, firmament. And the letters are divided into five outlets, which are  A Ch H Ā  [gutturals],  G Y K Q  [palatals],  D Ṭ L N T  [linguals],  B V M P  [labials],  Z S Sh R Tz  [dentals]; and they are hinted in five sefirot, which are Gedulah, Gevurah, Tiferet, Netzach, Hod; for Yesod is included in Tiferet, "body and covenant are counted as one," as we explained. And their division, according to what appears: the letters  A Ch H Ā  are in Gedulah; and because Gedulah is the most concealed and precedes the other sefirot, so these letters precede the other letters in their outlet, and they are concealed within the throat. And  G Y K Q  are in the palate; and they are in Gevurah; more revealed than the first ones and more hidden than the other letters. And  D Ṭ L N T  are in the tongue; and it is in Tiferet; and it is more revealed than Chesed and Gevurah; and likewise Tiferet is called tongue, as is known, and we explained it in the Gate of Ten and Not Nine. And the letters of the teeth are  Z S Sh R Tz; and they are in Netzach, the fourth emanation; and they are more revealed than the other letters, and more outward in their outlet than the other letters. And the letters  B V M P  are the letters of the lips; and they are in Hod, which is more revealed than the other sefirot mentioned; and therefore they are outward of all the other outlets. And they went the way of their emanation in the secret of light, waters, firmament, as we explained in the saying mentioned.

And behold, the letters, the manifestation of the source of their coming into being is from Binah, as we explained; for from there is the beginning of the revealing of their illumination; but with the help of Chokhmah. And so Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained in the Song of Songs (in the Zohar Chadash, fol. 87b), these are his words: "At the hour that the letters went out from within the world to come," etc. The upper Shekhinah is called the world to come; and he was precise in saying "from within," to show her inwardness, that is, her aspect from Chokhmah. And likewise it is said there: "Come and see: Bereshit: in this reshit is the secret of the upper point. Bara Elohim: by the power of this point the letters went out and were portrayed in their tikkunin."

Behold, the letters are in Binah, even though they are with the help of the power of Chokhmah, as he said, "by the power of this point." And with this is understood what is expounded (there, fol. 87a), these are his words: "The letters are inscribed in upper secrets; for all of them went out from the secret of the upper Wisdom, in those thirty-two tracks that go out from Wisdom." And the intent is that through the help of the tracks that are in Chokhmah, which were bestowed in Binah, that effluence, the beings of the letters came into being in Binah; and not literally a being, but the beings of the light, as we explained above; which is not so in Chokhmah, in which they were not even in the manifestation of the light, nor otherwise, because of their great subtlety. And one should not explain that the letters were literally from Chokhmah; for Rashbi, peace be upon him, has already explained the matter in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 70, fol. 123b), these are his words: "'And their rings [gabbeihem]' (Ezek. 1:18): this is the upper Mother, who is over the sefirot that are beneath her, from whom are all the letters. 'And as for their height [govah]': this is Chokhmah, from which are the vowel points." Behold, explicitly he said that the letters are from Binah; which is not so with the vowels, which are in Chokhmah, as we shall explain with the help of the Name. And many like these in the Tikkunim. And to the parts of this inquiry with which we have occupied ourselves in this chapter the author of the Sefer Yetzirah intended in one mishnah, these are his words: "Twenty-two letters, engraved in the voice, hewn in the air, fixed in the mouth, in five places:  A Ch H Ā,  B V M P,  G Y K Q,  D Ṭ L N T,  Z S Sh R Tz." Thus far his words.

And behold, it has already been explained in the Gate of ABYA the matter of inscribing, engraving, hewing, making; and we explained that the inscribing is subtler than the engraving, and the engraving subtler than the hewing, and the hewing subtler than the making, as is explained there.

And behold, we said that in Chokhmah there is no manifestation of the beings of letters at all, and the beginning of their coming into being is from Binah. And because in Chokhmah, which is the complete subtlety, which is the inscribing, there was no manifestation of the coming into being of the letters at all, therefore our mishnah did not mention "inscribed," as is its custom, and began from engraving onward, and said "engraved in the voice": that is, their coming into being in Binah, which is called voice. And therefore he said "engraved in the voice"; and even though the seven sefirot too are called voices, nevertheless the principal of the voice is in Tiferet within Binah, and through its manifestation in Binah she is called voice. And the hewing, which is the matter of the firmament, a true revealing; for the waters are (not at all) only an intermediate aspect between light and firmament; and their principal is in the firmament, which is in Tiferet; for it is not called an array in substance except in the firmament or in Binah, because there is the beginning of the array. And for this he said "hewn in the air [ru'ach]"; for ru'ach is Tiferet, the intermediate air that arbitrates between the fire and the water, as we explained above in the Gate of Arbiters; and it is Tiferet, and in it is the hewing. And afterward he said "fixed in the mouth": the matter of the fixing in the mouth is making [asiyah], and the mouth is Malkhut. It is found according to this: Beriah in Binah, that is, engraving; Yetzirah in Tiferet, that is, hewing; fixing, that is, Asiyah, in Malkhut. And likewise Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah are explained in these places in the Tikkunim, and we copied it in the Gate of ABYA.

And the matter of "in five places" [mekomot]: that is, five Names; as "Blessed be the Place [ha-Makom]"; and Makom comes to [the square of] YHVH; and that is five Names, five sefirot, as we explained above. This is what appears to us in the explanation of this mishnah, in the way of the words of Rashbi, peace be upon him, that we set first. And there is no wonder at the mishnah, that it arranged the order of the outlets not according to the order of the sefirot that we explained; because it took the order of the letters: that is,  A Ch H Ā, that is, Alef;  B V M P, that is, Dalet [Bet]; and afterward  Z S Sh R Tz, that is, Heh [Zayin]; and it intended neither the order of the outlets nor the order of the sefirot. However, the commentators said that large letters are a hint in Chokhmah, and middle letters in Tiferet, and small letters a hint in Malkhut. They will mean that when the letter is large it hints that it shines with the light of Chokhmah that flows upon it; and likewise middle ones shine with the light of Tiferet, and small ones shine with the light of Malkhut. And there is a demolition of this from the Zohar (Parashat Lekh, fol. 93); for explicitly he said that the Heh of "Do you thus requite [ha-la-YHVH]" (Deut. 32:6), which is large, is in Binah, to hint at her light; and afterward he said that it is to hint at the secret of the moon in its fullness; and he said there that this last is the principal, as we explained in the Glossary of Titles in the entry Heh. And likewise close to this in Parashat Vayikra, fol. 1 (on small or large letters). It is found that there is no proof for their words at all:

And now we need to set first one introduction, and with it our occupation in this gate will be concluded. And the matter is that, even though he said "such-and-such a letter hints at such-and-such a sefirah," the intent is not that that letter literally hints at the very self of that sefirah; for the letters are not the whole very self of the sefirah; rather they are separate forms, spreading out and emanated from the sefirot themselves. And it is not fitting to think that these forms are forms separate from the sefirot and a matter by themselves, like angels and like chariots; rather they are a part of the parts of the sefirot. And the matter is that in each and every sefirah there are a thousand thousands of thousands and myriad myriads of kinds of emanation and worlds and branches and manifestations, which neither human imagination and intellect can contain, nor even angels. And there is a letter that has revealed in its manifestation some branches of such-and-such a sefirah; and there is a letter that will reveal some branches of that same sefirah, and not those branches but others. And there is a letter that will reveal the thing more in generality, and the branches that four letters or five and the like include will be included in it; and they are included in this letter because of its great subtlety and its nearness to the very self of the root. And there is a letter whose attachment will be in Tiferet; but that Tiferet may be the Tiferet that is in Malkhut, or the Tiferet that is in Yesod, or the Tiferet that is in Gevurah; and so for the other sefirot, and their divisions and their manifestation and their aspects. And with this it is now possible that, even though the letter Vav is in Tiferet, as is well known, nevertheless it is included in the letters  B V M P, which are in the lip, as we explained, which are in Hod; and in this way for all the outlets, and in this way for all the sefirot: all according to the branches, and all according to the generalities and the particulars. And we shall lengthen this introduction somewhat more. And the matter is that the living creatures and the chariots and the ofannim that descend in a chain within the palaces all draw and suck a spirit of grace and emanation and effluence and sustenance and life from within the sefirot, each one to the known branches and to the manifestation of a known aspect, according to the aspects and according to the manifestations, as is well known to their Emanator and their Creator. And since so, according to this the letter will be found hinted rung after rung, to thousands and to hundreds, one after another, until the thing rises to the root of all the rungs that are hinted there. And according to this the letters Vav-Heh will be found in Tiferet and Malkhut; and likewise they will be found related to the face of the man and the face of the eagle that are in the living creatures, which draw from them; and they themselves are Vav-Heh; except that these are a source for those, and between them there is a great difference. And likewise they will be related to Uriel and Raphael. And so is the way of all the rungs that are emanated, these from within those, rungs after rungs; except sometimes in the branches and not in the roots, and sometimes in the roots and not in the branches, and sometimes in this and in that, according to the manifestation of the letters in their disposition. And the matter further is that sometimes they hint at the upper sources and the causes themselves, and incidentally at the lower branches. And in this way the letters change in their spirituality and in the manifestation of their emanation, even when they are equal letters; like the matter of the upper Vav and the small Vav: that this one hints at the root, which is Tiferet, and that one hints at the branch, which is Yesod; and sometimes it hints at the place of the root, which is the upper Vav in Keter. And nevertheless all is one, united, bound in a strong and firm bond, as the flame bound to the coal; so the effect is bound to its cause, and it is not fitting to separate this from that. And because of the lack of knowledge of the union and bond of the worlds and their descent one from another, the knowledge of the action of the Names has been concealed, even if their action is found in a book scroll. And whoever pursues the action of the Names will find "the gall of asps" in his honey; for it is possible for him to compose good with evil or evil with good, or at least "to confound his father's couch"; and then he will profane and "cut the shoots," God forbid. And nevertheless it is fitting for the modest to search after their knowledge; for they are good, to know the greatness of our Creator; and that one be, in the world to come, of those who give a reason in the knowledge of the hidden things of the Torah and its secrets.
And behold, the chapter is completed and this gate is concluded, with the help of the Name:
The Gate of Vowels, which is Gate Twenty-Eight:

After we explained in the previous gate the matters of the letters, a sufficient notice, we shall come in this gate to explain the matter of the vowels in general, and one by one in particular, to find the reckoning, according to what is found in the words of Rashbi, peace be upon him, with the help of the Name:
Chapter One:

What is well known among all the sages of Israel, a tradition from mouth to mouth from Ezra the Scribe, and he received it from mouth to mouth back to Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, from Sinai, from the mouth of the Gevurah, is that the vowels in their kinds are twelve. And these are five kings; and their sign is "the engravings of a signet" (Exod. 28:36), which are the signets of the degrees, "Holy to YHVH." And their names: shuruk with Vav, chirik with Yod, tzeirei, cholam, kamatz. And their form: the shuruk, a point within the Vav, like this [וּ]; and the chirik, a point beneath the letter, like this [פִּי]; and the cholam, a point above the letter, like this [וֹ]; and the tzeirei, two points one beside the other beneath the letter, like this [חֵי]; and the kamatz, a line stretched from the right to the left and a point beneath it, like this [תָּם]. Further, there are servants to them; and they are five, and are included in four; for in the chirik the difference between servant and king is its being with Yod or without Yod; and they are a notarikon. Beneath cholam is sheva and kamatz together, and they make the movement of the cholam. And beneath kamatz is patach; and it is a line drawn from the right to the left, like this [טַ]. And beneath tzeirei is segol; they are three points, the two one beside the other as in tzeirei, and one beneath them, opposite the space between them, like this [רֶ]. And beneath shuruk is shuruk [kubbutz], which is three points, one beneath another and that beneath another, like a root, drawn a little diagonally to the right, like this [קֻ]. Behold nine. Further, there is one, and it is a servant to the servants, and all the more so to their masters; and it is called sheva; and it is two points one above the other, like this [שְׁבָא]. Further, the patach and the segol are composed with the sheva, after the manner of their composition with the kamatz, even if their movement does not change, after the manner in which the movement of the sheva-kamatz changed; and this is its form: in be-emor, le-emor, and likewise la'asot, and many like them. The vowels are found to be nine simple and three composite, among the servants and the kings. And these are their number in this way: kamatz, patach, tzeirei, segol, sheva, shuruk, shuruk [of three points], which they call kibbutz sefatayim [pursing of the lips], and it has a correct reason according to the way of truth, and it will be explained with the help of the Name; cholam, chirik: behold nine simple. And three composite: sheva-kamatz, sheva-patach, sheva-segol; and they call them chataf kamatz, chataf patach, chataf segol; and they will be explained with the help of the Name. And before we enter into the explanation of these vowels, we need to set before them introductions, like the matter of the letters in the previous gate: that even though the vowels are equal, in equal letters, nevertheless their aspects and their souls and their spirituality change.

And further, we shall bring a proof from the book Berit Menuchah; and it is a pleasant book on the explanation of ten vowels of the four-letter name. And from its words it certainly appears that they are words of tradition from mouth to mouth, or from the mouth of an angel; for they are not things attained by much study or subtlety of intellect, but a wondrous apprehension, near to the holy spirit. And the rule is: he explained there ten vowels that are in the four-letter name; and we shall copy one here in extreme brevity, and from this we may infer to the rest, as will be explained in the Gate of Permutation, with the help of Heaven. He said that the vocalization of the four-letter name is YHVH; and its sign is kamatz, tzeirei, kamatz, chirik. And he said that the kamatz is one light, like a firmament spreading out, and its name is Akhteriel; and a spark beneath the firmament, one light, and its name is Adiron; and the two of them, their totality is kamatz. And beneath the Heh, tzeirei; and they are two lights: the first turns northward, etc., and its name is Yehadriel; and the second, its name is Zohariel; and the two points hint at the two lights. And beneath the Vav, kamatz; and the firmament is a hint to one light of ten letters, Yitzetziah Tzitziah; and beneath it one light, and it is a point beneath the firmament, and its name is Tafihotza. And beneath the last Heh, chirik; and it is one light, and its name is Azbugah.

Behold, explicitly: the kamatz is not like the kamatz, neither in the firmament nor in the spark; and each one of them is a name by itself and a light by itself and a world by itself. And from this we may infer to the other vowels that are in the other Names; for of all of them he explained that what this one hints at in its vocalization, that one does not hint at in its vocalization, as is explained there. And there it is explained that even if the vowels are equal, in equal letters, their vowels are not equal in their hint; and because of the brevity it is not in my power to copy its matter here. And in this there is certainly no wonder that different explanations, one from another, are found in the vowels; for it is possible that all comes up to one place and to one matter. And now we shall come to the explanation of the vowels in their arrangement, according to what is found in the words of Rashbi, peace be upon him, in the book of the Zohar; for his words are above all:

On the explanation of the vowels cholam, shuruk, chirik, because of their relationship, as will be explained. The cholam is head to all the vowels; and if it is small in quantity it is great in quality. And as is explained in the science of grammar, the letters  A H V Y  are letters of extension; the explanation, that all the syllables go out through them; like the cholam, after whose movement there is always a Vav, except that sometimes it is concealed. However, the principal hint of this vowel is Malkhut, when she rises above to be her husband's diadem, as it is written (Prov. 4:9), "a crown of glory [ateret tif'eret] shall she deliver to you." For Malkhut, in her rising to "her father's house" (Lev. 22:13), her high place, the place of Chokhmah, as we explained in the Gate of Manifestations, then she is her husband's diadem. And this is cholam, which is one point; and it is over the Vav, which is Tiferet, like the likeness of the diadem on the head of a man. And then she stands in the Supreme Crown; for she rises by way of the middle line to the three first ones, as is known; and then all the worlds sit in the exaltation of the effluence and the blessing. The rule of the matter: cholam is Malkhut when she is her husband's diadem; and therefore the cholam sometimes hints at Tiferet. And likewise you will find that the cholam hints at the Supreme Crown and at Chokhmah and at Binah, because she rises by way of the line upon her husband and is united in the three first ones, as we explained.

And further, it is found that cholam [Chet-Lamed-Mem] in numerical value is Yah in the small reckoning, to hint at the three first ones, which are included in the name Yah, as is known. And therefore it is found that this vowel is above the letters, to hint at an upper and high place, as we explained. And the shuruk that is within the Vav: the hint is to her manifestation in the union of her husband, lying in his bosom; and it is shuruk, "a noble vine [sorek], wholly a right seed" (Jer. 2:21). And because this union is through Yesod, which is what unites and binds these two attributes, as is known, the shuruk is hinted with the Vav in it. And even if in truth the Vav is the hint in Tiferet, and the shuruk, which is the point in the middle, the hint in Malkhut in her rising to her husband's house, nevertheless it hints in Yesod, after the manner of the name  Y A H D V N H Y, whose secret is Tiferet and Malkhut together, and it hints in Yesod, for their union is through it. And many other matters like these. And likewise SHuRuK in permutation is KoSHeR [binds], to hint that it binds the sefirot and unites them. And the chirik: its hint is to the manifestation of Malkhut when she is in her place beneath Yesod, beneath the thorns of the letters, whose hint is in Yesod, and the chirik beneath them. And these three aspects Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 10, fol. 23b), and these are his words: "And in cholam she is a crown on his head; and in chirik she is a throne beneath him; and in shuruk she is union toward him, like this." Thus far his words.

And by this is understood what the commentators explained, that the chirik is judgment, because it is the soft attribute of judgment. And to this hints "they hiss [sharku] and gnash [va-yachreku] the teeth" (Lam. 2:16); for the intent is to say that the shuruk, which is "the king's daughter, all glorious within" (Ps. 45:14), "leaning upon her beloved" (Song 8:5), they turned her to be chirik, like the matter of the exile; and they drove out the queen and removed her from her mastery, God forbid, "till YHVH look down and behold from heaven" (Lam. 3:50). And there is one who explained cholam in the Supreme Crown, and said that it is called cholam from the language of beginning [hatchalah], as it is written (Gen. 11:6), "and this they begin [hachillam] to do"; and he explained that it is the beginning of all the sefirot; and it is above the letter, to hint that it is the head that bestows to all that is beneath it. And concerning the shuruk in the Vav he explained that it is the beginnings of Keter, which is revealed somewhat and is not so much revealed. And concerning the chirik he explained that it is Malkhut, in the secret of the blue that is in the fringes:
On the explanation of the three servants, which are the shuruk of three points, and chataf kamatz, and chirik without Yod.

Behold, the servants are from the side of Malkhut, even if they hint at their upper source, as you will see with the help of the Name. For from her side is the servitude and the subjection, and from the side of above is the freedom, as is known.

And behold, because Malkhut is "the mirrors of the serving women" (Exod. 38:8), in which all the upper visions are seen, and she is what reveals all the hidden things, as is known, and in her all the hosts of above are seen; therefore all five vowels whose hint is the five upper ones, Gedulah, Gevurah, Tiferet, Netzach, Hod, have mirrors in which those lights and hosts are seen in Malkhut. And it is not our wish to say that the attributes are seen in her through these vowels alone; for we have already explained in the Gate of the Four-Letter Name that the sefirot are seen in Malkhut in nine vowels, and she includes all of them. But our intent is that those branches and lights that are seen in the upper ones through the five kings are seen in her through the five servants.

And behold, the servant of the cholam is the chataf kamatz. And the reason is that it shows the upper lights in particularity, and not in concealment so much as the upper ones. And because the vowel cholam, its foundation is hinted in the three first ones, and through her husband their totality is found to be five sefirot, Keter, Chokhmah, Binah, Tiferet and Malkhut, behold, he showed this matter in particularity: for the kamatz is a hint to the three first ones when they are united in the Supreme Crown, as we shall explain with the help of the Name; and the sheva is a hint to the two lights, Tiferet and Malkhut, one above the other, a small light and a great light. Therefore this vowel serves the service of the cholam; for the chataf kamatz reveals the vowel cholam. For above it is concealed and included in a subtle source; and here in Malkhut it is revealed in two sources, and their totality is five. And as for what is found, that sometimes the kamatz alone serves the vowel cholam, we can explain it in this way: that in the kamatz Chokhmah and Binah are also included, and they are Keter, Chokhmah, Binah, as we explained; and Tiferet and Malkhut in the firmament, which is the Vav, Tiferet, and the point that is beneath it, which is Malkhut; for so they explained kamatz, as we shall explain with the help of the Name. And behold, in the kamatz the five sefirot were revealed, even if they were somewhat concealed:

And the servant of the shuruk is the shuruk of three points, which they call kibbutz sefatayim; when Malkhut reveals the manifestation of this great movement, which is the union of a wife and her husband, as we explained in the previous chapter, which are cholam, shuruk, chirik. And because, when she is at the rung of the [three-point] shuruk, she shines by way of these three divisions, which are  Ch Sh Q , for through the union in which she is united above and below and middle; so her hint is in the shuruk of three points, above and below and middle. And so Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 10, fol. 25a), and these are his words: "And when she is a crown on his head, and she is a daughter beneath his feet, and she is in his union in his bosom, she is made shuruk, his knot." Thus far his words.

And his intent is that when Malkhut wishes to reveal these three manifestations, she makes shuruk [of three points]; and it is in Malkhut a servant to the shuruk. And one may not say that the explanation is that when Malkhut attains the three rungs together, then there will be [the three-point] shuruk; for if so, the shuruk of three points, which is a servant, would be found more praiseworthy than the shuruk in the Vav, which is a king.

And further, for so too Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained in the Song of Songs (in the Zohar Chadash, fol. 88a), and these are his words: "Shuruk of three points: at the hour that the letter Vav departed from her, she brought out knowledge from that which she took from within the upper one, as is said; and in the place of the letter Vav, shuruk goes out." Thus far his words. And behold, explicitly: when the union of her husband departs, and her will is to reveal what she received, she reveals the shuruk of three points, to hint at the three manifestations that she attains through the mediation of her husband:

And the servant of the chirik is chirik without Yod. And the matter is that when she is with the letter of extension, which is Yod, then her upper source is revealed upon her; and then she is likened to the king's son [daughter], which is the lower Wisdom, which receives from the King, which is the upper Wisdom, as he explained in the Sefer ha-Bahir. And when she is without Yod, then she is a servant, showing her own self without any joining of Chokhmah at all. And we can say in this a dessert: that when she is joined to her source, then she hints chai rak [only life]: the explanation, chai, that she receives the life from Chokhmah; and rak, that is to say, even though she is alone below, for her husband is not united with her in the secret of shuruk, cholam. But chirik without Yod will mean from the language of "they hiss and gnash the teeth," as we explained above. And there is one who explained the shuruk of three points as Keter, Chokhmah, Chesed, which are in the order of three points like this: the upper one above, drawn toward the middle side, like Keter; and the two drawn to the right side, in Chokhmah and Chesed, which are right:

On the explanation of tzeirei and segol. Tzeirei, two points: they are the two great lights, which are Tiferet and Malkhut, when they are great and equal. And this is when Tiferet rises to Chesed and Malkhut to Gevurah; for so is their way, male to the right, female to the left; and then they are united in union and equal, as they were before, opposite one another, united by the power of Gevurah and Gedulah, in the secret of the embrace, as is explained in the Gate of Essence and Governance. And behold, their true union is in the secret of the middle firmament, which is called shamayim, in the secret of esh and mayim: fire from the left, Gevurah; water from the right, Gedulah; and the firmament, Tiferet, the middle, which unites them. And through this Tiferet and Malkhut are united, to be the two great lights. And in this it will not be difficult if it is sometimes found that tzeirei hints at Chesed and Gevurah, and sometimes at Tiferet and Malkhut; for all comes up to one place. And behold, it is known that the manifestation of the secret of their union, to be the two great lights, is through Binah; for of her it is said, "the moon said before the Holy One, blessed be He," as we explained in the Gate of the Diminishment. And since the manifestation of their return to the secret of tzeirei, that is what is explained in the Gate of the Four-Letter Name: that the vowel of the name of Binah is tzeirei. And according to the truth, the manifestation of their union is the middle point that is between Gedulah and Gevurah, which is Tiferet; for there is its degree from the days of old. And behold, according to this this vowel will now be found to include all these compositions: whether that it be in Tiferet and Malkhut, when they are the two great lights; or that they be Chesed and Gevurah, and their being fire and water; or in Tiferet, the middle point alone; for it unites the fire and the water and includes them through the joining of Malkhut; and the two of them are concealed and only the two extremes are seen; but there is peace between them through Peace. And also it is related in Binah; for by her power the two faces, the groom with his bride, were united, as we explained. And all the orders of these explanations are found in Rashbi, peace be upon him, in the Tikkunim, one here and one there; and we reconciled his words as we explained:

And the servant of the tzeirei is the segol. And behold, the segol added a middle point, which is concealed in the tzeirei and in the segol is revealed; except that it is not literally Tiferet, which is concealed, but Yesod, standing between the water and the fire. And because sometimes their union is through Netzach and Hod, as we explained in the Gate of Essence and Governance, therefore the segol is sometimes related to Netzach, Hod, Yesod; and sometimes the union is raised in the cleaving of the three roots that are over them; and for this reason it is related also to Gedulah, Gevurah, Tiferet. Nevertheless their principal is in Netzach, Hod, Yesod. And when this vowel is related to the three Patriarchs, it is related also to Tiferet alone, because in it all is included, as is known. And for the reason that Malkhut reveals the things and the union more than the upper sources, she reveals segol in the place of the tzeirei, to hint that the matter of the tzeirei, which are Tiferet and Malkhut through Gedulah and Gevurah, in the secret of Tiferet and Yesod, as we explained above: she added in the revealing of Yesod, which mediates the peace between them. And therefore the segol is the servant of the tzeirei, as is known. And for the reason that this union is through Chesed and compassion, which are those that delight in union and compassion, which is not so on the side of Gevurah; for from the side of the force of her judgment she separates from her husband, to strengthen the judgment, to take "the vengeance of the covenant" blemished by iniquities; therefore the segol, which shows the union, is related to Chesed, as Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained, and we copied it in the Gate of the Four-Letter Name. And it is possible to say another reason: because the tzeirei is in Binah, as we explained; and the servant of Binah is Chesed, which is a chariot to Binah; and Chesed is called segol; therefore the segol is called the servant of the tzeirei. And our first one is principal. And for the reason that the segol shows the union of Tiferet and Malkhut through Yesod, Rashbi, peace be upon him, said in the Song of Songs that the [three-point] shuruk that is in Malkhut and the segol are all one matter; except that it changed in Malkhut; for from her side her husband is above and she below, and Yesod, which unites them, in the middle; and from the side of Tiferet the two of them are equal, in the secret of the great lights, and Yesod beneath the two of them. And even though it seems somewhat to disagree with what we wrote above on the [three-point] shuruk, all comes up to one place. However, it is difficult: for in the Tikkunim Rashbi, peace be upon him, explained that tzeirei is in Binah and segol in Chesed; and in the Song of Songs he wrote that tzeirei is in Chesed and segol in Gevurah. And it seems to me that what he explained in the Song of Songs, the intent is on their appearing and their revealing: for the revealing of Binah is in Chesed; and therefore the tzeirei that is in Binah is revealed in Chesed; and the revealing of Chesed is through Gevurah, for "this is a husk to that and that a brain to this"; and therefore the segol that is in Chesed is revealed through Gevurah. And there is one who explained: tzeirei is a hint to Metatron and Yehoel, two angels who stand like tzeirei; and likewise they hint at Michael and Gabriel. And concerning the segol he explained that they are Michael and Gabriel and Sandalfon, whose order in the Chariot is like the order of the segol. Thus far. And it is a wondrous thing that Sandalfon should be below Michael and Gabriel; for behold, Sandalfon is above, in the seventh palace, and Michael and Gabriel in the sixth palace, as is explained in the Gate of Palaces (and see Tikkun 70, fol. 125a, that the tzeirei and the segol hint at the angels explained there):

On the explanation of kamatz and patach. On the kamatz the explanations in the words of Rashbi are many, and the expressions various; and we shall explain his words as Heaven shall instruct us. In one place he explained that the kamatz is in Keter; and he explained the intent: to hint at its concealment; for it is closed [kamutz] and treasured, as is known. And elsewhere he explained: "Kamatz, a clenched fist [kometz] of three sefirot." And elsewhere he explained that kamatz is in Chesed, and proved his words from the passage "and the priest shall take his handful [ve-kamatz]" (Lev. 5:12; Num. 5:26). And elsewhere he explained that kamatz is Tiferet and Malkhut, in the secret of Vav, shuruk, explained in the first chapter. We have already explained in the Gate of Essence and Governance, chapter 15, the additional concealment of the three first ones over the other sefirot; and they explained in the Zohar (Yitro, fol. 93), on the passage "you shall in any wise let the mother go" (Deut. 22:7), that it is Binah, as is explained there at length. And if so, according to this it follows that Chesed is what reveals all the upper things that are enclosed and concealed in the three first ones; for from it downward is the beginning of the revealing. And behold, according to this the principal of the closing and the concealment is in Keter, with the joining to it also of Chokhmah and Binah, for they too are concealed, even if not as its concealment.

And behold, when we discern Binah and Chokhmah with respect to the aspect of Keter, they are certainly revealed; and on the contrary, they are what reveal all the concealed things that are in Keter; and therefore kamatz is related only to Keter. And when we discern them with respect to the other lower sefirot, we find them concealed, and all the more in their joining to Keter; and therefore the three of them are related by the name kamatz. And because the revealing of the three first ones that are included in the name kamatz is through Chesed, if so it is fitting that the manifestation of the kamatz be related also to Chesed, to show that the kamatz that is concealed above is revealed through it. And further, for Chesed is a veil, a screen concealing the upper things and hedging them about, and bringing out their manifestation to the lower ones; if so, the name kamatz is related to it, because it closes [kometz] and shuts in the upper Emanation, as we explained.
